Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2019

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima juta enam ratus lima puluh

enam ribu dan enam ratus ringgit (RM5,656,600) daripada Kumpulan Wang

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Skim Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2019 adalah dengan ini

dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 47(1) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2019.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2019

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding five million six hundred fifty six thousand and

six hundred ringgit (RM 5,656,600) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme for

the year 2019 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

 (RM)

Emoluments 1,798,900

Supplies and services 1,341,300

Other expenditures 10,400

Landed properties, plants and equipment 2,506,000

________________

Total 5,656,600

Made 28 February 2019

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)744/II]

M. KULASEGARAN

Minister of Human Resources
